package.name: safety_island_msgs
package.description: Messages of the L4 safety island's HPC interface (RFC_L4_SafetyIslandDesign V1.0, sections 8.1 and 8.2) and the island-internal messages its contract names. One set of .msg sources for ROS 2 (rosidl, this CMakeLists.txt) and nano-ros (resolved from package.xml through NROS_INTERFACE_SEARCH_PATH).
